title: The Zapatista Uprising of 1994
goal: Explain what the Zapatistas did and why using para que with the subjunctive, and put the events in order.
grammar: para que + subjunctive, present and imperfect

items: I can say what someone did so that something would happen, with *para que* and the subjunctive.
I can put the main events of the Zapatista story in order, with their dates.
I can say who said what, attributing it with *según*.
